purpose: Bound the Encounter & Balance Design Laboratory foundation to verified repository evidence without promoting observations or authored methodology into source truth.

evidence_classes.authority: completed governed PPIA/Internal Alpha contract; downstream boundary only
verified deterministic test/observation evidence; not canon
PPIA-11 design guidance; must be labeled as methodology

governed_balance_anchor.workstream: 8D-007 Golden Test Corpus and Balance Harness

inherited_contracts.encounter_boundary: Encounter balance output is advisory; Definition, placement and live-instance identities stay distinct; deferred creatures receive no invented CR/stat/mechanics.
Resource, equipment, quantity, mutable state and action costs remain owning-domain state; numerical balance conclusions route to PPIA-11.
Semantic movement/environment, systems, resources, station authority and damage remain PPIA-04; action output and resource cost commit atomically; unknown capacity is not zero/unlimited.
Biological traits, forms, adaptations, senses, movement, compatibility and vulnerabilities retain source/owning authority; encounter/balance calibration routes to PPIA-11.
SCI measures structural/cognitive complexity, not power; CSL is not failure probability/damage; no universal mana/cost formula; final balance calibration remains PPIA-11.

Scenes may place/link Encounter, objective, hazard, spawn, trigger and Event references; encounter definition, tactical resolution and final balance remain PPIA-11/MV-IA-F012; map art/geometry does not imply threat.

explicit_non_assumptions: No universal challenge-rating, encounter-level, power-score or cross-domain scalar is recovered by these sources.
No target band is a universal balance guarantee; 8D-007 target bands are within-domain deterministic comparisons.
A benchmark result, observed metric, regression threshold or recommendation is not source truth.
Action economy cannot be reduced to hit points or damage alone.
Unknown capacity, compatibility, capability, vulnerability, resource maximum or source mechanic is not zero, unlimited, absent, compatible or safe by default.
Creature, character, vehicle, mecha and spacecraft scale are not numerically interchangeable without an explicit governing rules context.
Map pixels, dungeon geometry and visual density do not determine threat, legality or balance.
SCI/CSL do not encode rune power, success probability, damage or universal resource cost.
Post-playtest calibration may recommend changes but never rewrites canonical source mechanics automatically.
PPIA-11 does not activate application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid services or production credentials.
